input.overview: Magic Wizard rewards two parallel completions: spell W-I-Z-A-R-D through the six lanes to raise the lit drop targets to 50,000, and finish either five-target bank to light the center standup for 50,000. Plunge for the hard I lane, shoot whichever drop target is lit, then collect the center standup after a bank falls.
input.simpleOverview: In Magic Wizard, plunge the I lane, then spell W-I-Z-A-R-D through the six lanes. Shoot the currently lit drop target; completing either five-target bank lights the center standup for 50,000, and completing W-I-Z-A-R-D makes lit drop targets worth 50,000. The add-a-ball Wizard copy uses WOW awards instead.
input.summary: The score grows sharply only after a bank or the letter set is complete. Use the plunge for I because it is difficult to reach later, take lit drop targets as their lamp cycles on switch hits, and collect the center target promptly after either bank is down.

quickInfo.name: W-I-Z-A-R-D
quickInfo.summary: Complete the six letter lanes to light the drop targets for 50,000 on Magic Wizard.

quickInfo.name: Drop-target banks
quickInfo.summary: Completing either five-target bank lights the center standup and that side's outer return lane.

quickInfo.name: Center standup
quickInfo.summary: Collect 50,000 after either bank is complete; the hit resets the completed bank.

quickInfo.name: Wizard boundary
quickInfo.summary: The add-a-ball Wizard copy uses WOW awards and different bank-completion logic; check the apron before using the points route.

steps.text: Plunge for the I lane; use later plunges for any other missing W-I-Z-A-R-D letter.
Watch the lamps above the ten drop targets and shoot the currently lit target for its higher value.
Finish either five-target bank, then shoot the newly lit center standup for 50,000 before rebuilding that bank.
Keep collecting letter lanes until W-I-Z-A-R-D is complete, then prioritize the lit drop target for 50,000.
Use upper rubber rebounds to reach Z or A; on the replay scoring setup, either lane can award both letters.
Spell W-I-Z-A-R-D through the six lanes.
Collect the lit drop target or center standup without crossing into the add-a-ball rules.

techniques.name: Aiming and shooting
techniques.instruction: Use the lamp above the drop bank as the aiming cue; wait for the lit target rather than spraying at the whole bank.

machineSetup: Identify Magic Wizard's replay scoring card versus the add-a-ball Wizard card. Confirm whether Z or A spots both letters, the 50,000-point values, and the installed ball count.
Test all six letter lanes, ten drop targets and their cycling lamps, both bank resets, the center standup and lamp, outer return-lane lamps, alternating bumpers, and tilt penalty.
